name: Krunchies — Restaurant POS & Online Ordering Platform
tagline: A full restaurant management system connecting online ordering, POS, and kitchen operations in real time.
description: A production restaurant management platform built for a real food business — customers order online, staff manage it through a POS interface, and admins run the business from a dedicated dashboard, all backed by a single Go API.

coverImage.alt: Placeholder mockup for an AI workflow product

problem: Independent restaurants juggle disconnected tools — a website for orders, a separate POS at the counter, and no unified view for the owner. Orders get lost between systems and there's no single source of truth for the business.
approach: Designed a single backend serving three purpose-built frontends — a customer ordering site, a staff POS interface, and an admin dashboard — so every order, no matter where it's placed, flows through one system.
solution: Built a Go (Gin) REST API backend with a shared data layer, and three separate Next.js frontends tailored to each user type: customers browsing and ordering, staff processing orders at the counter, and owners tracking the business.
outcome: Currently live and in active use across two restaurant locations, handling real customer orders end-to-end from website to kitchen.
architecture: Full-stack web architecture with a customer-facing ordering layer, operational POS interface, centralized backend services, and persistent business data. The system is structured around shared order, product, inventory, and sales workflows so that online and in-store operations remain synchronized.
